card.name: The word in after differences (geriatric use)
card.fires_on: The word "in" right after "differences" (or after "younger patients") in geriatric-use statements about response in elderly versus younger subjects.

modes.label: differences in response
modes.description: "in" following "difference(s)" in the standard sentence on elderly versus younger response.
modes.example: Other reported clinical experience has not identified differences<< in>> responses between the elderly and younger patients.

modes.label: in after younger patients
modes.description: "in" after a comparison with younger patients, introducing the trial setting.
modes.example: were observed between these patients and younger patients<< in>> either the initial therapy trial or the second

card.plain: It marks the little word "in" in the stock sentence saying no differences in response were seen between older and younger patients.
